capabilities: Create client notes with contact details
Create project notes with rate type, rate amount, and deadline
Generate invoice notes summing un-invoiced time logs
Show a dashboard of active projects with hours and estimated earnings
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track freelance clients, billable hours, or generate invoices from logged work.
summary: Freelance business tracker that manages clients, projects, time logs, and invoice generation as plain Markdown notes in the vault.
